trust_decision.summary: InstrumentationSettings.include_content decides whether exception message, stack trace and ERROR-status description may be exported on OTel spans; at the pinned commit only the tool-validation span honours it, every other span records the full exception (explicitly or via the SDK's start_as_current_span/use_span defaults).

landing_point.why: The summary names 'tool and agent run spans'; the explicit span.record_exception calls in _run_tool_span sit right below the already-redacted validation-error branch (lines 393-407), which is the obvious template to copy.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Realtime sessions are a separate feature whose wrap_run is skipped (capabilities/instrumentation.py:189-190) and record_error is a @staticmethod with no access to settings, so a solver can argue the report's 'tool and agent run spans' do not include realtime or the model-request span.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: With include_content=True the exception event must keep exception.message/stacktrace and the run/chat span status description must stay 'Type: message'; a BaseException (cancellation) must stay unrecorded on the run span as use_span did; tool spans keep ERROR status without description; a non-recording span must not format the exception. An over-broad fix (always type-only, or catching BaseException on the run span, or dropping the status) breaks these.
